build_encoder_subclass: build a python module that subclasses EncoderBase to create a custom VAE encoder for a new dataset
create_mlp_encoder: create a ColorMnistMLPEncoder instance with a given latent dimension to encode ColorMNIST images into posterior parameters
sample_from_posterior: sample latent vectors from a normal posterior distribution using ColorMnistMLPEncoder sample method with a JAX random key
review_encoder_architecture: review the ColorMnistMLPEncoder MLP architecture with four hidden layers of 200 units each and a final output layer
refactor_normal_params: refactor the _normal_params_from_logits function to support a different distribution parameterization beyond mean and variance
